text: 深交所：2026年8月31日至9月4日，本所共对95起证券异常交易行为采取了自律监管措施，涉及盘中拉抬打压、虚假申报等异常交易情形；共对13起上市公司重大事项进行核查，并上报证监会2起涉嫌违法违规案件线索。
text_en: Shenzhen Stock Exchange: From Aug. 31 to Sep. 4, 2026, it imposed self-regulatory measures on 95 cases of abnormal securities trading, involving intraday price manipulation, false orders, and other irregularities; reviewed 13 major corporate events of listed companies and reported 2 suspected illegal or non-compliant case leads to the CSRC.
